name: Giving Back
overview: Scripture teaches that giving back to the Lord is an act of honoring Him with the firstfruits and tithes of all increase, recognizing that all we have belongs to Him (Leviticus 27:30; Proverbs 3:9). Failing to bring tithes and offerings is described as robbing God, but faithful giving invites His abundant blessing (Malachi 3:8-10). Jesus emphasizes that where our treasure is, there our hearts will be also, and He calls believers to freely give as they have freely received, reflecting the generosity of Christ (Matthew 6:21; 10:8).
